findings.article_section: Scope and the date of the evidence
findings.explanation: Canonical eCFR pages displayed Title 17 current through October 1, 2026 when inspected October 4. The article distinguishes title-wide dates, historical 2025 readings and the unofficial eCFR legal edition.

findings.article_section: Item 303: explain the business effects behind the numbers
findings.explanation: Selected paragraph map matches annual/interim, offsetting change, cash horizon, estimate uncertainty and nonduplicative explanation provisions. It is explicitly not a complete checklist or materiality decision.

findings.article_section: Items 307 and 308 ask different control questions
findings.explanation: Item 307 concerns officers’ disclosure-controls conclusions; Rule 13a-15(e) describes the disclosure information process while (f) defines ICFR. The revised scope expressly selects Section 12/Rule 13a-15 rather than implying every domestic reporting issuer follows that route.

findings.article_section: Items 307 and 308 ask different control questions
findings.explanation: For the expressly covered domestic case, Rule 13a-15 distinguishes quarterly disclosure-controls evaluation, annual ICFR evaluation and changes evaluation. Scope and special cases remain explicit.

findings.article_section: Items 307 and 308 ask different control questions
findings.explanation: Item 308(a)-(c) and Instructions 1-2 support separate management/attestation/change analysis, material-weakness limitation and new-issuer transition. No filer/EGC status is decided.
Product movements, percentages, horizon sums and chronology were checked. These facts do not establish real materiality, funding sufficiency or effective controls.

findings.article_section: Build a scope matrix; Sources and limits
findings.explanation: Rule 12b-2, alternative Rule 15d-15, actual form requirements and all cross-references were not fully verified. Their application is clearly withheld.

Only original explanation/examples and brief source descriptions are included. Government regulation sources are linked; no publisher branding, protected standard body or source rights grant is included.

changes_summary: Added an explicit Section 12/Rule 13a-15 scope assumption and left the Section 15(d)-only route for separate research.
Verified selected rule claims against dated official eCFR text and retained historical-2025 separation.
Checked original product-driver, cash-horizon and chronology examples without professional conclusions.

Correction on October 4, 2026: independently recalculated product growth as +45% and -30%, then serialized both verified tuples as (45, -30). The article bytes and substantive source-review scope are unchanged.
unresolved_gaps: Actual filer/EGC status, Rule 12b-2 and alternative Rule 15d-15 applicability remain unverified.
No reconciliation of developments after the displayed October 1, 2026 current-through date or every cross-reference.
No human professional review, accounting/audit assessment, legal opinion or full compliance determination.
